theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (U : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (a : ℕ → Euclid n) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (χ : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P), (∀ j, IsOpen (U j) ∧ closedBall (a j) (r j) ⊆ U j ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (χ j) (U j) ∧ InjOn (χ j) (U j) ∧ CountablyRectifiable n (χ j '' U j) ∧ μHE[n] (χ j '' closedBall (a j) (r j)) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ w ∈ U j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (χ j) w) ∧ ∃ y ∈ V, ψ y = χ j w ∧ F y = t ∧ fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ e, inner ℝ v (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (χ j) w : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ) ∧ ψ '' {y | y ∈ V ∧ F y = t ∧ fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ j, χ j '' ball (a j) (r j)
